tool_input.command: node pigment-snap.mjs --measure /settings/billing ".settings-group" ".plan-grid" ".payment-method" ".tbl" ".bp-fig" ".tbl th.num" ".tbl td.num" ".tbl th.pin" 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s.slice(s.indexOf('{')));for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(j))for(const e of v.slice(0,3))console.log(k,JSON.stringify(e.box),e.padding,'gapNext',e.gapToNext??'')})"
